geometry.label: pass2_relief2
geometry.withdrawal_condition: Clear all yellow connector material from the removal path first. Intersecting branches can need more than one cut; the proof is for fin bodies, not scissors access or force.
geometry.temporary_core_policy: Orange fins can traverse empty assembly space only while printing; all must be removed before hardware installation, along the verified path.

fit.label: pass2_relief2
fit.reference: Frozen O22F4_Compact actual body including prior reliefs
fit.proof: Permanent edits are bounded subtractions. For every nearby actual assembly neighbor, preserve the old body material in a exact local Minkowski sum with a 0.05 mm cube, constructed from exact boundary triangle plus cube sums, clipped to each edit region before union. Compare material volume rather than min_gap on zero-volume coplanar Boolean remnants. All axis endpoints and 12 combined poses are checked; pre-existing collision poses are not asserted attainable.
